command:
set -eu
inventory_entry=$(getent passwd inventorysvc)
inventory_uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
inventory_gid=$(id -g inventorysvc)
inventory_sys_uid_max=$(awk '$1 == "SYS_UID_MAX" { print $2; exit }' /etc/login.defs)
[ -n "$inventory_sys_uid_max" ]
[ "$inventory_uid" -le "$inventory_sys_uid_max" ]
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$inventory_entry" | cut -d: -f6)" = /var/lib/inventory ]
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$inventory_entry" | cut -d: -f7)" = /sbin/nologin ]
[ -d /var/lib/inventory ]
[ "$(stat -c %u /var/lib/inventory)" -eq "$inventory_uid" ]
[ "$(stat -c %g /var/lib/inventory)" -eq "$inventory_gid" ]
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'PASSWD_ENTRY=[REDACTED] "$inventory_entry"
printf 'IDENTITY='; id inventorysvc
printf 'SYS_UID_MAX=%s SYSTEM_UID_CHECK=pass\n' "$inventory_sys_uid_max"
printf 'HOME='; stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G uid=%u gid=%g mode=%a type=%F' /var/lib/inventory
printf 'PASSWORD_STATUS=[REDACTED]id -un' 2>&1)
inventory_login_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'LOGIN_ATTEMPT_RC=%s\n%s\n' "$inventory_login_rc" "$inventory_login_output"
[ "$inventory_login_rc" -ne 0 ]
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'FAILED_UNIT_COUNT='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' | wc -l
